name: player_alt_gun_fire_slot_offset
description: Player alt-gun fire slot offset helpers decay or clear pending slot offsets and apply the resulting offset to the slot node matrix.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the Player alt-gun/runtime-state source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x43a900 validates the fastcall PlayerGunFireSlot/node ABI, frame-delta damping factor built from -8.09f and 12102200.0f, tiny-offset clamp below 0.01f, matrix posY/posZ writes, and optional gwObject3DSetMatrix call.

Binary Ninja assembly for 0x43a980 validates the fastcall save-state ABI, gunNode null guard, nonzero tests for left/right/center alt-fire slots, offset clearing before helper dispatch, left/right applyMatrix=1, and center applyMatrix=0.
The native smoke verifies direct damping/matrix writes, tiny-offset clamp behavior, all three save-state slot clears and matrix resets, and the gunless early-return path.
